corrections.why: Three sources give a 15-foot pole tower (about 4.6 m). The 6.1 m figure matches the 20-foot height in the 1933 Forest Lookouts entry, which is the outlier.
Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts both name the Priest Lake TPA. Only the Forest Lookouts page says National Forest.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: 1932 in Firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and WillhiteWeb; 1933 in Forest Lookouts (attributed to Kresek). Used 1932.
15 feet (about 4.6 m) in three sources; 20 feet in Forest Lookouts. Used 15 feet.
Priest Lake TPA in Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts; National Forest in Forest Lookouts. Story reports both.

sources.title: Lost Creek Ridge Fire Lookout Tower

notes_for_editor: Brief height 6.1 m looks like the 20-foot Forest Lookouts figure; three sources say 15 feet. Agency: brief says National Forest, which only Forest Lookouts says; the Priest Lake TPA name is in two sources. Brief access 'unknown' left unset; WillhiteWeb describes a hike but does not state a closure or permission rule. Idaho Fire Lookouts lists no staffing history. The WillhiteWeb page is a personal site, so its footing captions are the only evidence of what remains.
